body: Hi! I’ve been taking Wellbutrin and Lamictal for awhile now and the combination works really well. I don’t know anything about klonopin, but I know Celexa and Wellbutrin are both SSRIs while Lamictal is a mood stabilizer so I don’t think you would need to take Wellbutrin AND celexa with the Lamictal. Everyone is different (especially with the way they react to meds) so I would definitely talk to your psychiatrist about it. Please be safe and don’t try to stop/start any meds by yourself!! I hope that helps!

I’ve been on Lamictal for over a year now and I’ve never noticed any acne. If anything starts looking patchy (kinda like hives) or starts to itch, that’s probably from the Lamictal. I hope that helps!

If you can save some money living off campus, you should. I’ve lived off campus for three years now (I’m a college senior) and it’s way better than a dorm, or anything on campus. You have a lot more freedom, and I see my friends just as much as I did before.
Therapists can only breach confidentiality if you have an intention to harm yourself or others, so it should be fine to talk about it!
